description: Re-building and extension of existing detached single storey garage. Installation of three side roof windows to the rear wing of the main house, and one rear roof window to the main roof
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL-000, PLG-003, PLG-004, PLG-005, PLG-006, PLG-007 and Design and Access Statement received: 04/10/2019. PLG-001 Rev A and PLG-002 Rev A received: 09/10/2019. PLG-008 Rev A received: 14/10/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the proposed extended outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used on the existing garage.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 78 Thornbury Road, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor as a business premises, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
